html:
In the metals industry, operational strength is essential — but true leadership also requires vision for the future. Preet Dass, Chief Operating Officer of JDass Group, is not only ensuring Dass Metal Products operates at peak performance today but is also preparing it to meet the evolving demands of tomorrow’s construction industry.

Driving Innovation in Steel Solutions

Under Preet’s leadership, Dass Metal Products has embraced modernization and advanced fabrication systems to enhance efficiency and precision. By investing in cutting-edge equipment and upgrading workflows, she ensures the company can serve both small contractors and large infrastructure projects with the same reliability.

Her approach emphasizes continuous improvement — adapting operations to meet client needs, scaling production for major developments, and staying ahead of new building trends in Ontario and across Canada.

“Innovation isn’t about chasing what’s new,” Preet explains. “It’s about building systems today that will serve communities for decades.”

Dass Metal Products Offerings and How Preet Dass Has Elevated Them

At the core of Dass Metal Products is a diverse range of steel framing and reinforcement solutions designed for modern construction. Under Preet Dass’s leadership, each product line has been refined to meet higher standards of precision, reliability, and sustainability.

Non Load-Bearing & Load-Bearing Steel Studs
Dass Metal provides both light-gauge studs for partitions and heavy-gauge framing for structural walls, floors, and roofs.

With Preet’s guidance, the company has adopted stricter quality control and certification processes, ensuring contractors can rely on Dass Metal studs for consistent performance across projects.
👉 Explore Steel Stud Systems

Track Systems – Standard, Deep, Slotted, and U-Flex
From standard track products to innovative U-Flex tracks for curved walls, Dass Metal’s track solutions reflect the company’s commitment to adaptability.

Preet has overseen investments in advanced forming equipment, improving accuracy in bends and slots and reducing material waste.
👉 View Track Offerings

Bridging Channels, Furring Channels & Resilient Channels
Stability and performance are critical in framing.

Preet has championed refinements in bridging and furring systems to enhance structural strength, while resilient channels are designed to meet the growing demand for acoustic insulation in residential and commercial builds.
👉 Learn More About Channels

Angles, Straps, Beads & Connectors
Utility angles, flat straps, corner beads, clips, and connectors may be small in size, but they are vital in delivering reliable framing systems.

Under Preet’s leadership, Dass Metal has streamlined production to ensure greater consistency and faster turnaround times, offering contractors dependable parts exactly when they need them.
👉 See Utility Components

Dass Rebar & Welded Wire Mesh
Beyond framing, Dass also supplies rebar and welded wire mesh for reinforced concrete construction.

A major milestone under Preet’s direction was achieving Ministry of Transportation (MTO) approval for Dass Rebar — a recognition that opened doors to large-scale infrastructure projects.

This achievement underscores her ability to scale operations while maintaining strict compliance with industry standards.
👉 Discover Dass Rebar

Sustainability as a Core Value

For Preet Dass, growth must go hand-in-hand with responsibility. That’s why Dass Metal Products has integrated sustainable practices into its Vaughan facility, including the use of district energy systems that reduce the environmental impact of operations.

She is also exploring new ways to reduce material waste, improve energy efficiency, and align Dass Metal Products with Canada’s broader sustainability and green building goals.

“Our steel doesn’t just build stronger communities — it also supports a cleaner, more sustainable future,” Preet says.

Preparing for Ontario’s Construction Future

Ontario is entering a period of record investment in housing, transit, and infrastructure. Preet Dass is ensuring Dass Metal Products is future-ready, with plans to:

  • Expand production capacity in Vaughan to meet growing demand.
  • Adopt advanced monitoring technologies for even greater quality assurance.
  • Collaborate with developers and municipalities on projects tied to urban growth.
  • Align with national infrastructure priorities, ensuring JDass Group’s metals division remains a key player in Canada’s development.

Leadership Rooted in Community

Beyond innovation and sustainability, Preet Dass is deeply committed to community impact. Through the JDass Charitable Foundation, she supports initiatives that give back to Vaughan and beyond — from meal programs at youth shelters to contributions that strengthen local services.

Her leadership reflects JDass Group’s Canada-first philosophy, ensuring that every achievement at Dass Metal Products ties back to strengthening the local economy and supporting Canadian communities.

About Preet Dass

Preet Dass is the Chief Operating Officer of JDass Group, where she oversees operational strategy and innovation across divisions. At Dass Metal Products, she is leading the company into the future by championing sustainability, modern technology, and a Canada-first vision.
